name: maharianto-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Aridya Maharianto.

plugins.name: save-plan
plugins.description: Save plan-mode plans to PLANS/<yyyymmdd-HHMMss>-<name>.md: on approval, or by typing a save request under "No, keep planning".

plugins.name: token-visualizer
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: context window ring, 5h and weekly usage bars with reset times, cache TTL countdown and hit rate.

plugins.name: paste-peek
plugins.description: Tiles above the prompt for each pasted image, long text and file path in the draft, stacked on top of token-visualizer's band.

plugins.name: wordsmith
plugins.description: Turns a rough prompt into a concise, structured one: asks about every gap instead of assuming, then puts the result in the input box unsent.
